summary: find options: excludes patterns, file_type (file, directory, link, any), follow symlinks, get_checksum, hidden, limit on results, mode matching, and the required paths list.
questions: How do I find directories instead of files?
How do I include hidden files in find?
How do I stop after finding the first match?
How do I exclude some file names from results?
How do I find files with a specific permission mode?

answer_card.title: find parameters: type, excludes, limit
answer_card.answer_md:
- `paths` (required; aliases `name`, `path`): fully qualified dirs
- `file_type`: `file` (default), `directory`, `link`, `any`
- `excludes`: patterns to remove from matches
- `hidden` (false), `follow` (false), `get_checksum` (false)
- `limit` (2.18+): stop after N matches (shallowest first)
- `mode`: match permissions, octal or symbolic
